design_lineage: Semi-Markov competing score-state generator was specified as the structural backbone before C070-A/B results. C070-C changes the learning task from direct Draw-label feature search to next-minute competing score-transition likelihood; failed C070-A/B features are not used.

changed_learning_task.training_population: all regular matches inside each chronological train window
changed_learning_task.final_draw_metric_role: secondary derived diagnostic from frozen transition engine; no calibration/tuning in C070-C

minute_binning.stoppage_mapping: all canonical score events with event minute >=90 are mapped to bin 89 so 90-minute settlement includes second-half stoppage without using realized stoppage duration as prematch input
minute_binning.multi_score_bin_policy: bins containing 2+ canonical score events are excluded from structural log-loss fitting/evaluation but all score events still update the following score state; count and rate must be reported

prematch_inputs.PIT: same C069 competition/team goal-rate construction; all matches on a UTC date are predicted before same-date update

state.score_diff_definition: home_goals_minus_away_goals at start of minute bin
state.state_duration: number of consecutive completed one-minute bins since the latest canonical score event; reset to 0 after any score event

derived_draw_evaluation.matched_test_rows: exact C069-R3 maximum-cardinality matched pairs only
derived_draw_evaluation.generator_probability: dynamic-programming probability mass at final score_diff=0 divided by mass at score_diff in {0,-1,+1}
derived_draw_evaluation.incumbent_C069_baseline: standardized logistic C=0.1 on baseline_logit; reported as external diagnostic, not structural gate

stop_lines.gate_pass: STRUCTURAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL_ONLY; freeze separate C070-D calibration/integration contract before any probability calibration or stacking
